question: For the players who had a 77 points overall rating on 2016/6/23, who was the oldest? Give the name of the player.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Information AS pi ON p.player_api_id = pi.player_api_id
WHERE pi.overall_rating = 77
  AND pi.date = '2016-06-23'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1
